about_the_game:
"Fast-paced, addictive, and full of variety! The upgrade system keeps each run fresh, and the pixel art style looks fantastic. A must-play for action RPG fans!"

- Awesome Games Review Group

"Vanquish Evil throws you into dense forests and flaming rings while unleashing wave after wave of monsters. Feels like a survival gauntlet on overdrive."

- IndieSight

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

FAST-PACED ACTION ROGUELIKE COMBAT

Vanquish Evil aims to take the most fun core gameplay from the ARPG/Roguelite genres -- and crank up the action to one thousand percent! Where player skill and strategic upgrade choices influence the run. Creating fun gameplay and high replay value is the goal. The game in it's current state is built to have all character progression in-game for that specific run, which gives the game a lot of replay value. Currently the game has just begun meta progression development. "Meta Items" are now being added as unlocks.

THE STORY

A supernatural cosmic battle is being fought for the mortal realm, and much of the world is already in ruin.

A final resistance of humanity are brave enough to fight. Many die, and are turned into undead armies who serve the formless evil cosmic presence known as Absolute Darkness (Vile).

Ascended Light (Veil), a cosmic presence in favor of saving humanity, send Cosmic Guardians to fight alongside the mortal armies.

The final elite army of heroes stand together to fight an apocalyptic war with one common goal...

Vanquish Evil.


SPECIAL FEATURES

Stylized hand-drawn pixel art, animation, and background art!
Original Music Soundtrack composed and produced by GnarlyTree!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized violence and cartoon gore, including explosions, monster dismemberment, and blood-like effects. There are no depictions of real-world violence, sexual content, or sensitive themes such as abuse or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required for gameplay (WASD + left click + hold button to fire missiles manually)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Vanquish Evil is an Action RPG Roguelite! Fast-paced action! A Randomized Upgrade System to choose your own path, and every run is unique! Explosive spell-based and melee upgrades! Stack upgrades for synergy! Features stylized pixel art!
